chunk_text: Should the 6th lord be in the 6th itself or in the ascendant/8th, there will be ulcers or bruises on the body. The sign becoming the 6th house will lead to the knowledge of the concerned limb.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 15 - EFFECTS OF THE 6th HOUSE (Part 1)

chunk_text: The Karaka of a relative or the lord of such a house joining the 6th lord or being in the 6th/8th house indicates ulcers/bruises to such a relative like father.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 15 - EFFECTS OF THE 6th HOUSE (Part 1)

chunk_text: Should the lord of the ascendant be in a sign of Mars or of Mercury and be aspected by Mercury, there will be diseases of the face.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 15 - EFFECTS OF THE 6th HOUSE (Part 1)

chunk_text: Mars or Mercury having ownership of the ascending sign and joining the Moon, Rahu and Saturn will cause leprosy.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 15 - EFFECTS OF THE 6th HOUSE (Part 1)

chunk_text: If the Moon is in the ascendant which is not however Cancer and be with Rahu, there will occur white leprosy.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 15 - EFFECTS OF THE 6th HOUSE (Part 1)

chunk_text: Saturn in place of Rahu will cause black leprosy.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 15 - EFFECTS OF THE 6th HOUSE (Part 1)

chunk_text: Mars similarly will afflict one with blood-leprosy.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 15 - EFFECTS OF THE 6th HOUSE (Part 1)

chunk_text: If the ascendant is occupied by the lords of the 6th and 8th along with the Sun, the native will be afflicted by fever and tumours.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 15 - EFFECTS OF THE 6th HOUSE (Part 1)

chunk_text: Mars replacing the Sun will cause swelling and hardening of the blood vessels and wounds and hits by weapons.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 15 - EFFECTS OF THE 6th HOUSE (Part 1)

chunk_text: Mercury so featuring will bring in billious diseases.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 15 - EFFECTS OF THE 6th HOUSE (Part 1)

chunk_text: Jupiter in similar case will destroy any disease.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 15 - EFFECTS OF THE 6th HOUSE (Part 1)

chunk_text: Similarly Venus will cause diseases through females.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 15 - EFFECTS OF THE 6th HOUSE (Part 1)
